21. Updation / Periodic Updation of KYC
Periodic updation from the date of opening of the account / last KYC updation shall be carried out at least once in every three years for high risk customers, once in every eight years for medium risk customers and once in every ten years for low risk customers for ensuring that the information or data collected under CDD is kept up-to-date and relevant, particularly where there is high risk as per the following procedure:
